parameters.query:
SELECT
    cia.assessment_id,
    cia.change_request_id,

    cr.change_request_code,
    cr.change_title,
    cr.change_description,
    cr.business_reason,
    cr.requested_by,
    cr.priority,
    cr.change_status,
    cr.requested_completion_date,

    p.project_id,
    p.project_code,
    p.project_name,

    cia.schedule_impact_days,
    cia.cost_impact,

    cia.schedule_rating,
    cia.cost_rating,
    cia.resource_rating,
    cia.technical_rating,
    cia.risk_rating,
    cia.overall_impact,

    cia.resource_impact,
    cia.technical_impact,
    cia.risk_impact,
    cia.ai_summary,
    cia.recommendation,

    cia.assessed_by,
    cia.assessed_at,

    latest_decision.decision_id,
    latest_decision.decision,
    latest_decision.decision_comments,
    latest_decision.conditions,
    latest_decision.decided_by,
    latest_decision.decided_at

FROM change_impact_assessments cia

JOIN change_requests cr
    ON cr.change_request_id = cia.change_request_id

JOIN projects p
    ON p.project_id = cr.project_id

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        cgd.decision_id,
        cgd.decision,
        cgd.decision_comments,
        cgd.conditions,
        cgd.decided_by,
        cgd.decided_at
    FROM change_governance_decisions cgd
    WHERE cgd.change_request_id = cia.change_request_id
      AND (
            cgd.assessment_id = cia.assessment_id
            OR cgd.assessment_id IS NULL
          )
    ORDER BY cgd.decided_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) latest_decision
    ON TRUE

WHERE cia.assessment_id = $1;
